description: Enforce wall-clock SLAs on asset compute. Timer wraps the compute call; on breach, emits AssetObservation tagged sla_breach=<key> with typed metadata (actual_seconds, expected_seconds, overrun_pct, escalated). Optional escalation: count recent breaches within a sliding window (via context.instance.get_event_records) and tag ESCALATED after N. on_breach=warn materializes with observation; on_breach=fail raises dg.Failure. Different from FreshnessPolicy — that governs SOURCE freshness; this governs compute wall-clock duration.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset. On breach: emits AssetObservation with breach metadata + fail/warn per policy. Composes with any downstream sensor for alerting.

asset_name.description: Dagster asset name. Required when NOT using `wraps:` (inherited from inner component in wraps mode).
asset_name.label: Asset Name

escalate_after_n_breaches.label: Escalate After N Breaches
escalate_after_n_breaches.description: Count breaches in window; tag ESCALATED after N.

escalate_window_seconds.description: Sliding window for breach counting (default 1 hour).
escalate_window_seconds.label: Escalate Window (seconds)

sla_key.label: SLA Key
sla_key.description: Shared SLA key. Defaults to asset_name. Set explicitly to group multiple assets under one SLA budget.
